name: 邻间 (Neighbor)
description: Login-free LAN chat and file sharing for DBX: a guest lobby, direct and group conversations, images and chunked file transfers, and Ed25519-signed transfers between trusted nodes. Hosts a local HTTP node on port 53318 by default and can join another private-IP node.
releaseNotes: First store listing of 邻间 (Neighbor), a login-free LAN IM for DBX: guest lobby, direct and group chat, images and chunked file transfers, and trusted node-to-node transfers. Ships six x64/ARM64 packages for Windows, macOS and Linux; backend and frontend tests run on the three OS runners and packages are cross-compiled with GOOS/GOARCH. 0.1.3 adds the Apache-2.0 LICENSE to the repository and inside every .dbxp (covered by the package checksums), and aligns the docs and UI version labels. Earlier 0.1.x tags are source-repository history only and were never submitted to the store. 首次上架：免登录局域网通讯；0.1.3 补齐 Apache-2.0 许可证并统一文档版本。
